phq9.q1: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by little interest or pleasure in doing things?
phq9.q2: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by feeling down, depressed, or hopeless?
phq9.q3: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much?
phq9.q4: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by feeling tired or having little energy?
phq9.q5: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by poor appetite or overeating?
phq9.q6: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down?
phq9.q7: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by trouble concentrating on things, such as reading or watching television?
phq9.q8: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless?
phq9.q9: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way?

gad7.q1: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge?
gad7.q2: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by not being able to stop or control worrying?
gad7.q3: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by worrying too much about different things?
gad7.q4: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by trouble relaxing?
gad7.q5: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by being so restless that it's hard to sit still?
gad7.q6: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by becoming easily annoyed or irritable?
gad7.q7: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by feeling afraid as if something awful might happen?

pss.q1: In the last month, how often have you been upset because of something that happened unexpectedly?
pss.q2: In the last month, how often have you felt that you were unable to control the important things in your life?
pss.q3: In the last month, how often have you felt nervous and stressed?
pss.q4: In the last month, how often have you felt confident about your ability to handle your personal problems?
pss.q5: In the last month, how often have you felt that things were going your way?
pss.q6: In the last month, how often have you found that you could not cope with all the things that you had to do?
pss.q7: In the last month, how often have you been able to control irritations in your life?
pss.q8: In the last month, how often have you felt that you were on top of things?
pss.q9: In the last month, how often have you been angered because of things that happened that were outside of your control?
pss.q10: In the last month, how often have you felt difficulties were piling up so high that you could not overcome them?

cssrs.q1: In the past month, have you wished you were dead or wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
cssrs.q2: In the past month, have you actually had any thoughts of killing yourself?
cssrs.q3: Have you been thinking about how you might do this?
cssrs.q4: Have you had these thoughts and had some intention of acting on them?
cssrs.q5: Have you started to work out or worked out the details of how to kill yourself? Do you intend to carry out this plan?
cssrs.q6: Have you ever done anything, started to do anything, or prepared to do anything to end your life?

burnout.ex5: I feel burned out from my studies.
burnout.cy1: I have become less interested in my studies since my enrollment.
burnout.cy2: I have become less enthusiastic about my studies.
burnout.cy3: I have become more cynical about the potential usefulness of my studies.
burnout.cy4: I doubt the significance of my studies.
burnout.ef1: I can effectively solve the problems that arise in my studies.
burnout.ef2: I believe that I make an effective contribution to the classes that I attend.
burnout.ef3: In my opinion, I am a good student.
burnout.ef4: I feel stimulated when I achieve my study goals.
burnout.ef5: I have learned many interesting things during my studies.
burnout.ef6: During class I feel confident that I am effective in getting things done.
